# Rollup 5 import attributes tests

Import attributes tests from Rollup 5, ported from the `rollup-5` branch of rollup/rollup at `07e139fd7`. The folders mirror `test/function/samples` and `test/form/samples` there.

The `rollup` submodule is still on Rollup 4, whose tests expect the old behavior. Delete this folder once the submodule moves to Rollup 5 and `packages/rollup-tests` runs the originals.
